text: In the summer of 2020, the Toronto Transit Commission graciously agreed to temporarily suspend the use of the Toronto Transit Commission stop on the south side of Gerrard St. East at Ashdale Avenue in order to accommodate a few curb lane cafes in the Gerrard India Bazaar Business Improvement Area as part of CafeTO. The CafeTO program in 2020 provided a lifeline to many in the struggling hospitality industry and brought some joy to our pandemic weary city. After a long dreary winter of lockdown restrictions, local restaurants will need these expanded outdoor dining areas of CafeTO more than ever. Even with vaccine roll-out, there are many challenging months ahead. The design and implementation work for CafeTO has already started so that once it is deemed safe to do so by public health officials, open air, street side dining will once again enchant Toronto's neighbourhoods. However, there…

City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Transit Commission to consider temporarily suspending the use of the Toronto Transit Commission stop on the south side of Gerrard Street East at Ashdale Avenue in order to accommodate curb lane cafes at that location as a part of CafeTO, and City Council request that the appropriate restaurateurs, Toronto Transit Commission staff, City staff and the Gerrard India Bazaar Business Improvement Area be advised of that decision as soon as possible.
